abstract: The cell differentiation properties of thirty-four sacrococcygeal teratomas (SCT) and their five recurrences were immunohistochemically studied for the expression of different classes of intermediate filament proteins, muscle actin (MA) and S-100 protein. Out of thirty-nine tumors twenty-three were SCTs with only mature tissue elements, seven immature teratomas, five pure endodermal sinus tumors (EST) and four ESTs or embryonal carcinomas (EC) combined with mature components. Cytokeratin positivity was found in all epithelial structures and sometimes also in smooth muscle and primitive mesenchymal cells. An intense cytokeratin immunoreactivity was observed in EC and EST components. Muscle markers, desmin and MA were present in smooth and striated muscle cells. Focal desmin positivity was also found in some epithelial structures in two cases. Glial tissue positive for glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP) was found in twenty-eight out of thirty-nine tumors. Some cases with no apparent glial tissue in hematoxylin and eosin staining showed glial differentiation as proved by GFAP positivity. In six out of eleven choroid plexus-like tissues GFAP positive cells were observed. S-100 protein showed an intense distribution of immunoreactivity outside neural tissue, and focal positivity was observed in malignant epithelial structures. Immunohistochemical markers did not reveal any prognostic significance in teratomas. Our findings, however, showed some aberrant features of cell differentiation from normal mature tissue components but closely parallel to those found in normal fetal development.
abstract_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫34例およびその再発5例の細胞分化特性を、中間径フィラメント蛋白、筋アクチン（MA）、S-100蛋白に対する免疫組織化学的検索により検討した。39腫瘍のうち、23例は成熟組織成分のみからなる仙尾部奇形腫、7例は未熟奇形腫、5例は純粋な卵黄嚢腫瘍、4例は卵黄嚢腫瘍または胎児性癌が成熟成分と混在していた。サイトケラチンは全ての上皮構造に陽性で、時に平滑筋や原始間葉系細胞にも陽性であった。卵黄嚢腫瘍および胎児性癌成分では強い陽性反応を示した。デスミンとMAは平滑筋および横紋筋細胞に存在した。2例では一部の上皮構造にも限局性のデスミン陽性がみられた。グリア線維性酸性蛋白（GFAP）陽性のグリア組織が39腫瘍中28例で認められた。HE染色で明らかなグリア組織を認めない症例でも、GFAP陽性によりグリア分化が確認された例があった。脈絡叢様組織11例中6例でGFAP陽性細胞が認められた。S-100蛋白は神経組織外で強い免疫反応性を示し、悪性上皮構造にも限局性の陽性がみられた。奇形腫において免疫組織化学マーカーは予後的意義を示さなかった。一方、分化異常の一部は正常成熟組織成分からの逸脱を示し、正常胎児発生で観察される所見によく類似していた。
